title: Map settings, grouped and searchable
summary: All map settings is now organised into clear groups with a search box, instead of one long list.
items: Groups: This map, Places & party, Players & display, Exploration, Combat, View, and Shortcuts & help.
Type in the search box to show only the groups that mention it, or jump straight to a group from the row of buttons at the top.
The places on the map, once their own tab, are now in Places & party.
Shortcuts & help lists every map keyboard shortcut.
